info.name: LJVIS — ERRU RSI
info.description:
Functional tests for the ERRU RSI module, Stage 6 (LJVIS2-147): create/revise draft, GET, permission boundaries (rsi.read / rsi.create), optional block semantics (driver block closed by default, identificationDetails choice: transport_undertaking and owner sub-types), checkedItems round-trip, and all field-level validation codes.

Ruuter-on-Rust allowlist contract: every field listed in the endpoint allowlist MUST be present as a key in the request body — the key may be absent causes 500 'Field missing: <field>'. The value may be either "" (empty string) or null — both are treated identically by the extractRequestData DSL step (via `incoming.body.field || ''`) and produce NULL in the database via NULLIF(:field, ''). Newman tests use "" for optional fields; the frontend may send null — both are correct.
